title: Comparison of the effect of air tamponade versus no tamponade after pars plana vitrectomy for idiopathic epiretinal membrane

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License)

condition: Idiopathic epiretinal membrane (no glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy, vein occlusion or AMD; posterior vitreous detachment required); 25-gauge pars plana vitrectomy with ERM and ILM peeling by one surgeon, combined with cataract surgery in all phakic eyes; full air tamponade when an atrophic hole or lattice degeneration was present, otherwise balanced salt solution (no tamponade); prospective cohort (Hangil Eye Hospital, 2015-2018); 2-year follow-up

groups.agent: pars plana vitrectomy with ERM and ILM peeling, no tamponade (balanced salt solution)
pars plana vitrectomy with ERM and ILM peeling, full air tamponade, prone positioning for one day
groups.description: Air group (air used when an atrophic hole or lattice degeneration was present)

series.notes: mean ± SD (Table 3 footnote); 'Central' location of the ETDRS grid; times from surgery (preoperative; 1, 3 and 6 months; 1 and 2 years); per-visit n and handling of missing visits not stated

series.baseline_label: Preoperative (Table 3, 'Central' location, Air row; row-spanned visit label so cells start one column earlier)
series.notes: mean ± SD (Table 3 footnote); 'Central' location of the ETDRS grid; times from surgery (preoperative; 1, 3 and 6 months; 1 and 2 years); per-visit n and handling of missing visits not stated

exclusions.what: Table 3 superior, nasal, inferior and temporal locations
exclusions.reason: sector subfields are out of scope

exclusions.what: Table 1 R10 baseline CMT (total, BSS, air)
exclusions.reason: duplicates the Table 3 preoperative central values (same eyes); Table 3 is cited

exclusions.what: Table 2 visual acuity, spherical equivalent and IOP

exclusions.reason: retinal nerve fibre layer thickness is out of scope

notes: Combined phacoemulsification in phakic eyes (lens status in Table 1); intraoperative triamcinolone used for membrane peeling in some cases; treatment recorded as vitrectomy.
Visual acuity, refraction, IOP and peripapillary RNFL thickness are reported (not extracted).

Ambiguity resolved: tamponade was chosen during surgery from intraoperative findings, a treatment variant fixed at the time of treatment rather than a post-baseline outcome, so both arms are kept as control groups.
Ambiguity resolved: the Methods state that CMT was obtained from the ETDRS circle and Table 3 lists it as the 'Central' location next to the four sectors; recorded as central_subfield.
Ambiguity resolved: prior treatment of the membrane is not mentioned, so prior_treatment is unstated.
